page_title: LYO 1-2 LEN | Lyon v Lens 04/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nampalys Mendy departs the field of play to be replaced by Malang Sarr (Lens).
90+3' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
90+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lyon, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Facundo Medina (Lens) for a tough tackle.
89' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
88' Substitution. Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) has come on for Corentin Tolisso.
88' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
88' Lyon seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

85' 1 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Anass Zaroury (Lens) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top right corner. Lucas Perri just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:2.

82' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) attempts an acrobatic volley on the edge of the box, but it's a wild effort and flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.

79' 1 - 1 Clinton Mata showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header inside the right post. It's 1:1.
77' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
75' The referee awards a corner and Rayan Cherki (Lyon) goes over to take it.
74' Malick Fofana (Lyon) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
71' A substitution has been made. Nemanja Matic is replaced by Alejandro Gomes Rodriguez (Lyon).
71' Substitution. Anass Zaroury (Lens) on for Andy Diouf.
70' Will Still prepares a substitution. Goduine Koyalipou is replaced by Martin Satriano (Lens).
70' Here's the change. Tom Pouilly leaves the pitch and Hamzat Ojediran (Lens) comes on as a substitute.
70' Close! Clinton Mata (Lyon) is a whisker away from finishing-off the move he started. His close-range effort flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
69' A dangerous looking corner kick from Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) is cleared to safety by the defence.
67' Tom Pouilly (Lens) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
67' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
65' Half-chance! Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) plays a pass into the box, but Mathew Ryan reacts well to snuff out the attack.
64' Deiver Machado (Lens) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jeremy Stinat didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

63' Mathew Ryan doesn't have to worry about this one. Malick Fofana plays a pass into the feet of Georges Mikautadze (Lyon), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.

62' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lyon are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
59' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
58' Thiago Almada (Lyon) sends the corner into the box, but Mathew Ryan intercepts it and averts the threat.
58' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Now Lyon have a corner.
57' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
56' The Lyon players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
54' A yellow card for a tackle by Nampalys Mendy (Lens). Jeremy Stinat doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
52' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle and it's Andy Diouf (Lens) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
51' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
51' The Lyon players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
48' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
48' Thiago Almada (Lyon) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
47' Lyon work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

47' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lyon.
46' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Today's referee Jeremy Stinat rightly decides to book Malick Fofana (Lyon) for his harsh tackle.
45+2' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
45+2' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It will be a corner kick for Lyon.

45+1' CHANCE! Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) fires just wide of the left post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Rayan Cherki. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
43' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.

41' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
41' Great teamplay by Lyon as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
39' Malick Fofana (Lyon) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
37' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
37' Dangerous play by Andy Diouf (Lens). Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul. Lyon will take a free kick near the side line.

36' What a chance that is! Deiver Machado (Lens) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
35' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Rayan Cherki (Lyon) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Mathew Ryan was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
34' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lyon.
33' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul.

31' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
29' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

28' Thiago Almada (Lyon) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
27' Tom Pouilly (Lens) jumps into a tackle and Jeremy Stinat signals a foul. Lyon win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
26' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
26' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

25' Malick Fofana (Lyon) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lyon will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
25' Andy Diouf (Lens) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
24' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jeremy Stinat who sees an offensive foul.
21' 0 - 1 Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) collects the ball deep inside the box from a rebound following the corner kick. He beats the keeper with a sharp low shot in the middle! Quite a nice goal!
21' Lens force their opponents to concede a corner.

21' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Lucas Perri has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
18' A quickly taken corner by Lyon.

18' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Lyon will take a corner kick.
17' Malick Fofana (Lyon) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.

16' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Mathew Ryan shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
14' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) unleashes a decent strike heading to the bottom right corner, but the keeper dives like Superman and keeps it out.
13' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) for his blatant foul.
12' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
9' A pass by Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
6' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
5' Neat passing move from Lyon in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' The free kick from close range, taken by Lyon, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
1' Handball! A player from Lens handled the ball. It's a free kick to Lyon in a dangerous position.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Jeremy Stinat will referee today's match.
